subject.title: [Feature]: Channels settings page should always show built-in channels alongside custom channels

question: Should maintainers adopt and port the open fork PR at https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/544, or close it and request a fresh same-repository replacement?
rationale: The bug remains source-reproducible, but the open cross-repository PR already uses closing syntax and contains the focused resolver/test shape, so automation should not create a competing fix.

options.title: Adopt or port the fork PR
options.body: Use the existing focused patch as the implementation source, updating paths and proof as needed before merge.

options.title: Request a fresh same-repo PR
options.body: Close the fork candidate and ask for a new UI-only resolver/test PR against the current file layout.

recommendation.title: Adopt or port the fork PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing focused patch as the implementation source, updating paths and proof as needed before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly tied to the channel UI/catalog refactor and current Control UI file migration history.
